zh: 平均成绩只取决于每位学生的总分和出现次数，这两个量都可以边读边累加；姓名区分大小写，直接用原字符串作为键即可。
用哈希表按姓名维护（总分，次数）。比较两个平均数 s1/c1 与 s2/c2 时，因为次数都是正数，可以改为比较 s1·c2 与 s2·c1，全程整数运算，避免浮点误差。
读入 n 条记录并累加到哈希表；然后遍历所有学生，维护当前最优者的（总分，次数），若某学生满足 总分×最优次数 > 最优总分×次数 就替换为它；题目保证平均成绩互不相同，最后输出最优者的姓名。
en: An average depends only on each student's total score and number of appearances, and both can be accumulated while reading; names are case-sensitive, so use the raw string as the key.

Keep (total, count) per name in a hash map. To compare averages s1/c1 and s2/c2, since counts are positive you can compare s1*c2 with s2*c1 instead, staying in integer arithmetic and avoiding floating-point error.

Read the n records and accumulate them in the hash map; then iterate over all students, keeping the (total, count) of the best one so far and replacing it whenever total * bestCount > bestTotal * count; averages are guaranteed distinct, so finally print the best student's name.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Accumulate the total score and the count for each name. Compare averages by cross-multiplication to avoid floating-point error.

## Proof of correctness

The accumulated values give each student's average as a numerator and a denominator; with positive denominators, cross-multiplication is equivalent to comparing the averages. Traversing all students and keeping the largest one finds the maximum, and uniqueness guarantees that the result is unique.

## Complexity

Time O(n+k), space O(k), where k is the number of distinct students.

## Source notes

This site supplied a deterministic standard input/output protocol. In upstream problem 9, the dense-arrival example omitted the completion time of one admitted guest; this site corrected it to 3301 according to the explicit 300-second service and queue rules, and states this truthfully in the source evidence.
